# StargateV2PoolArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/StargateV2PoolArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[Ark](../ark.md)

**Title:**
StargateV2PoolArk

Ark contract for managing token supply and yield generation through Stargate V2 pools and staking

Implements strategy for depositing tokens into Stargate pools, staking LP tokens, and harvesting STG rewards


## State Variables
### stargatePool
The Stargate pool this Ark interacts with


```solidity
IStargatePool public immutable stargatePool
```


### stargateStaking
The Stargate staking contract


```solidity
IStargateStaking public immutable stargateStaking
```


### lpToken
The LP token from the Stargate pool


```solidity
IERC20 public immutable lpToken
```


### weth
The wrapped native token (WETH) contract


```solidity
IWETH public immutable weth
```


### convertRate
The convert rate for the Ark


```solidity
uint256 public immutable convertRate
```


### isNativeAsset
Whether the asset is native ETH


```solidity
bool public immutable isNativeAsset
```


## Functions
### constructor

Constructor to set up the StargateV2PoolArk


```solidity
constructor(address _stargatePool, address _stargateStaking, address _weth, ArkParams memory _params) Ark(_params);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_stargatePool`|`address`|Address of the Stargate pool|
|`_stargateStaking`|`address`|Address of the Stargate staking contract|
|`_weth`|`address`|Address of the wrapped native token (WETH) contract|
|`_params`|`ArkParams`|ArkParams struct containing necessary parameters for Ark initialization|


### totalAssets

Returns the total assets managed by this Ark in the Stargate pool

Since Stargate V2 LP tokens are rebasing, the staked balance directly represents underlying assets


```solidity
function totalAssets() public view override returns (uint256 assets);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The total balance of underlying assets held in the pool for this Ark|


### _withdrawableTotalAssets

Internal function to get the total assets that are withdrawable

For rebasing tokens, we need to check the maximum withdrawable amount from the pool


```solidity
function _withdrawableTotalAssets() internal view override returns (uint256 withdrawableAssets);
```

### _board

Deposits assets into the Stargate pool and stakes the LP tokens


```solidity
function _board(uint256 amount, bytes calldata) internal override;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets to deposit|
|`<none>`|`bytes`||


### _disembark

Withdraws assets from the Stargate pool via unstaking and redeeming


```solidity
function _disembark(uint256 amount, bytes calldata) internal override;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets to withdraw|
|`<none>`|`bytes`||

Internal function for harvesting rewards from the multi-rewarder


```solidity
function _harvest(bytes calldata)
    internal
    override
    returns (address[] memory rewardTokens, uint256[] memory rewardAmounts);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes`||

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`rewardTokens`|`address[]`|The addresses of the reward tokens|
|`rewardAmounts`|`uint256[]`|The amounts of the reward tokens harvested|
